description: Retrieves attachments for a Trello card.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return (e.g., bytes, date, edgeColor, idMember, isUpload, mimeType, name, previews, url), or 'all'.
fields.title: Fields

filter.description: Filter for attachments: 'cover' for card cover, 'true' for all, or 'false' for non-cover (behavior can vary).
filter.title: Filter

idCard.description: The ID or shortLink of the Trello card from which to retrieve attachments.
idCard.title: Id Card

name: get_cards_attachments_by_id_card

AttachmentDetails.description: Details of a single attachment on a Trello card.

date.description: Timestamp indicating when the attachment was added.
date.title: Date

edgeColor.description: For image attachments, the extracted edge color.
edgeColor.title: Edge Color

fileName.description: Original file name of the attachment.
fileName.title: File Name

idMember.description: Identifier of the member who added the attachment.
idMember.title: Id Member

isUpload.description: Indicates whether the attachment was uploaded (true) or linked (false).
isUpload.title: Is Upload

mimeType.description: MIME type of the attachment file.
mimeType.title: Mime Type

pos.description: Position value for ordering attachments within the card.
pos.title: Pos

previews.description: If the attachment is an image, an array of generated preview images in various sizes.
previews.title: Previews

url.description: URL to access the full attachment.
url.title: Url

AttachmentDetails.title: AttachmentDetails

bytes.description: Size of the preview image in bytes.
bytes.title: Bytes

height.description: Height of the preview image in pixels.
height.title: Height

scaled.description: Indicates whether the preview is scaled.
scaled.title: Scaled

url.description: URL to access the preview image.
url.title: Url

width.description: Width of the preview image in pixels.
width.title: Width

attachments.description: List of attachments associated with the card.
attachments.title: Attachments
